pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, Four Knights, 6.Ndb5 Bb4 7.a3, 9.ed5 ed5 10.Bd3 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 blockaded with Nd4, which the c3-knight cannot reach in one move. Rewrote plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, Four Knights, 6.Ndb5 d6
pages.notes: Plan 1 set up a Maroczy Bind with c4, which the c3-knight blocks; plan 3 played ...b5 into the knight; plan 4 offered a Hedgehog. Rewrote plans 1, 3, 4 and the overview's Maroczy reference.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, Four Knights, 6.Ndb5 d6 7.Bf4
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...b5 into the knight. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, Four Knights, 6.Nxc6 bxc6 7.e5 Nd5
pages.notes: Plan 2 called the b-file open (half-open); plan 4 developed the bishop 'after ...a6'. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling in plan 3. Plan 1 (a knight route Ne2-c3 for the knight on c3) is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-24 (reviewer: first draft's Bc4 runs into ...cxd5).

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 5...a6 6.Be2 Nge7
pages.notes: British spelling in the overview and plan 2. Plan 1 (routes ...c8-b6, f4 as a move, a Hedgehog) is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-24 (reviewer: first draft tied ...Ng6 to the exchange on d4).

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 5...a6 6.Be3 Nge7
pages.notes: Plans wrote castling with zeros and played ...Be7 with the knight on e7; plan 2 called the queenside advance a minority attack. Rewrote plans 1, 2, 4. Plan 3 is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-24 (reviewer: first draft had a c8-knight supporting ...b5).

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Taimanov Variation, Bastrikov Variation, Ponomariov Gambit
pages.notes: The overview calls 8.Bb6 a bishop sacrifice and plan 2 has Black take with ...axb6, but the b6-bishop cannot be taken that way; the piece en prise is the b5-knight (8...axb5). A short search did not settle the theory of 8.Bb6 axb5 9.Nxb5, so the text was left unchanged.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.Be2
pages.notes: Plans named Nb5 as a Black move and wrote ...d6-d5 from a pawn still on d7. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.f4
pages.notes: Plans wrote castling as O-O-O in a way the parser could not read and named Nb5 as a Black move. Rewrote plans 1-2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 6.g3 a6 7.Bg2 d6
pages.notes: British spelling in the overview. Plan 3 (a d4-pawn that isn't there, ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8) is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-24 (reviewer: first draft had a c-file rook hitting the d4-knight).

pages.name: Sicilian: Taimanov, 5.c4 Nf6 6.Nc3
pages.notes: Follow-up to batch 2026-11-16-22: plan 4 rewritten with the right reason for 7.Nxc6 (Bd3 and castling break the pin).
